message.abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p>In vitro eradication of the <jats:italic>C. albicans</jats:italic> and <jats:italic>S. mutans</jats:italic> mixed biofilms by eugenol alone and in combination with the antimicrobial drugs. Previously characterized strains of <jats:italic>C. albicans</jats:italic> (CAJ-01 and CAJ-12) and <jats:italic>S. mutans</jats:italic> MTCC497 were used to evaluate the eradication of biofilms using XTT reduction assay, viability assay, time dependent killing assay and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Synergistic interaction was assessed by checkerboard method. Sessile MIC (SMIC) of eugenol was equivalent to the planktonic MIC (PMIC) against <jats:italic>C. albicans</jats:italic> and <jats:italic>S. mutans</jats:italic> mixed biofilms. SMIC of fluconazole and azithromycin was increased upto 1000-folds over PMIC. Eradication of single or mixed biofilms was evident from the viability assay and SEM. At 1 × MIC of eugenol, log<jats:sub>10</jats:sub>CFU count of <jats:italic>C. albicans</jats:italic> cells were decreased from 6.3 to 4.2 and 3.8 (<jats:italic>p</jats:italic> < 0.05) in single and mixed biofilms, respectively. SEM studies revealed the eradication of <jats:italic>C. albicans</jats:italic> and <jats:italic>S. mutans</jats:italic> cells from glass surface at 800 µg/mL concentration of eugenol. Time dependent killing assay showed dose dependent effect of eugenol on pre-formed CAJ-01, CAJ-12 and <jats:italic>S. mutans</jats:italic> biofilm cells. Eugenol was highly synergistic with fluconazole (FICI = 0.156) against CAJ-12 single biofilms. However, the combination of eugenol and azithromycin showed maximum synergy (FICI = 0.140) against pre-formed <jats:italic>C. albicans</jats:italic> and <jats:italic>S. mutans</jats:italic> mixed biofilms. These findings highlighted the promising efficacy of eugenol in the eradication of biofilms of two oral pathogens (<jats:italic>C. albicans</jats:italic> and <jats:italic>S. mutans</jats:italic>) in vitro and could also be exploited in synergy with fluconazole and azithromycin in controlling oral infections.</jats:p>
title: Synergistic interaction of eugenol and antimicrobial drugs in eradication of single and mixed biofilms of Candida albicans and Streptococcus mutans
